mono.purpose: Values, versions, provenance seals, and command output.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Lift the primary configuration surface only.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Registry row, field, and selection feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action for the current task region.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bounded alternative that does not compete with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-strong,#fff);color:var(--text,#17201f);font:650 13px/1 Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong,#aebbb7);background:var(--surface,#f8faf9);transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#0f766e);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Select Field
components.description: The standard labeled decision control for plan input.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;color:var(--text,#17201f);font:680 12px/1.4 Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-field select{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#f8faf9);color:var(--text,#17201f);font:600 13px/1.3 Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-field select:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent,#0f766e);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft,#d9eeeb)}

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Text-led rail navigation with a precise active-state marker.

components.name: Operation Ribbon
components.description: The durable status surface for running, complete, and failed operations.
components.html: OKInventory currentCatalog and machine state are ready.VERIFIED
components.css: .ds-operation{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:62px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-strong,#fff);color:var(--text,#17201f);font-family:Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-operation strong,.ds-operation small{display:block}.ds-operation small{margin-top:3px;color:var(--text-soft,#596562);font-size:12px}.ds-state{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft,#d9eeeb);color:var(--accent,#0f766e);font:700 10px/1 Cascadia Code,monospace}.ds-seal{padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);border-radius:999px;font:400 9px/1 Cascadia Code,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em}

components.name: Metric Ledger
components.description: Machine-state values presented as one divided record rather than separate cards.
components.css: .ds-metric{padding:16px 18px;border-right:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);color:var(--text,#17201f);font-family:Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-metric span,.ds-metric strong,.ds-metric small{display:block}.ds-metric span{color:var(--text-soft,#596562);font-size:10px;font-weight:700}.ds-metric strong{margin-top:8px;font:700 26px/1 Cascadia Code,monospace}.ds-metric small{margin-top:7px;color:var(--text-soft,#596562);font-size:11px}

components.name: Registry Row
components.description: A selectable capability record with description and provenance metadata.
components.css: .ds-registry-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:13px;align-items:start;padding:14px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);background:transparent;color:var(--text,#17201f);font-family:Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-registry-row:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface-strong,#fff) 58%,transparent);transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-registry-row strong,.ds-registry-row small{display:block}.ds-registry-row strong{font-size:13px}.ds-registry-row small{margin-top:4px;color:var(--text-soft,#596562);font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}.ds-seal{padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);border-radius:999px;font:400 9px/1 Cascadia Code,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em}

components.name: Record Seal
components.description: A compact ownership or provenance label, never a decorative tag.

narrative.overview:
AgentStack Manager is an operational provenance workbench. The interface separates observed machine state, plan inputs, reviewed changes, and authorized mutation so users can tell what is known, proposed, and permitted at a glance. Cold paper surfaces and graphite structure keep attention on records rather than decoration. Muted teal appears only where the user can act, where the current section is selected, or where verified state needs emphasis.

The system is compact and familiar because users arrive to complete a technical task. It avoids marketing-page composition, decorative motion, and repeated card shells. Registry rows, fine dividers, status seals, and one persistent workspace rail provide the product character.
keyCharacteristics: Preservation-first hierarchy with observed, planned, and authorized states kept visually distinct.
Restrained cold-neutral palette with one scarce action accent.
Workhorse sans typography for every task surface, with mono reserved for data and provenance.
Flat registry structure by default, with elevation used only for the main work surface and transient feedback.
Responsive behavior that changes topology instead of shrinking desktop type.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is reserved for primary action, current selection, focus, and verified state. It is never scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Honesty Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red communicate real system state. They do not create visual variety.

rules.name: The Work Surface Rule
rules.body: No separate display typeface enters the product UI. Hierarchy comes from weight, scale, spacing, and structure.

rules.name: The Mono Evidence Rule
rules.body: Monospace is evidence language, not a technical costume.

rules.name: The Topology Before Scale Rule
rules.body: Mobile changes structure first. It does not solve crowding by shrinking labels or touch targets.

rules.name: The Flat Registry Rule
rules.body: Records remain flat and divided. Elevation marks a work surface or a transient layer, never ordinary content.

rules.name: The Two Radius Rule
rules.body: Use 8px for controls and 12px for surfaces. Pills are status artifacts, not a general shape language.

dos: Do keep observed state, plan input, reviewed output, and authorization visually distinct.
Do reserve teal for action, selection, focus, and verified state.
Do use registry lines and negative space before adding another container.
Do keep every primary control at least 44px high and preserve visible focus.
Do use the mono stack for evidence such as values, versions, seals, and command output.
Do collapse layout topology at 1120px, 800px, and 520px before reducing density.
donts: Don't introduce a marketing hero, decorative dashboard cards, or promotional proof into the manager.
Don't add a second accent color, purple glow, decorative glass, or color without state meaning.
Don't animate layout-driving properties such as width, height, margin, or padding.
Don't hide navigation behind unlabeled icons or reduce touch targets to make mobile fit.
Don't use pills for ordinary buttons, panels, or form controls.
Don't use repeated eyebrows, section numbers, or technical microcopy as decoration.
